reference.name: Hermes Agent
reference.role: failure-class and shared-workload oracle, not StarNet design authority

promiseClasses.required: blocks v0.9 until proved or removed from the advertised surface
promiseClasses.experimental: must be labelled where used and must fail safely
promiseClasses.excluded: must not be advertised or included in parity scoring
promiseClasses.differentiator: StarNet-specific behavior graded on its own truthful contract

promises.releaseTreatment: Prove the clean installed under-ten-minute journey.
Prove BYOK and ChatGPT sign-in on the installed candidate.
Advertised provider families require connect, fail, revoke, and restart evidence.
Expose and prove the Settings writer or remove the claim.
Prove roster identity across a restart.
Prove bounded distinct concurrency and correct routing.
Prove streaming, attachments, stop, and transcript durability.
Reconcile tools, work state, tokens, model, and spend from runtime facts.
Prove placed gear grants and removal revokes without hidden authority.
Narrow the wording to the real room-scoped grants and prove that scope.
Remove authorization language; hallways are geometry in v0.9.
Do not claim graph execution; advertise only proven capability and belt projection.
Qualify watched versus explicitly granted unattended mutations and prove both.
Prove bless, revoke, forget, restart, and unattended refusal.
Prove a real project patch never touches main and never pushes.
Prove jailed artifact opening on the installed candidate.
Prove coherent cross-links without pretending every control is one panel.
Prove schedule, next run, result, pause, and process-lifecycle qualifications.
Prove a leash-bounded overnight run with truthful recap.
Prove visible tray-supervised continuation and explicit-quit shutdown.
Prove a cold-return report derived from durable evidence.
Require longitudinal evidence or narrow the claim to durable memory and rejection learning.
Prove real-token bidirectional lifecycle and delivery recovery.
Label all three at point of use and prove safe failure/revoke behavior.
Either extend verified keychain coverage to every advertised channel or narrow the claim.
Prove HTTP connect, discovery, failure, removal, and honest stdio refusal.
Label the catalog experimental until every auth tier has lifecycle proof.
Prove local storage and retain explicit third-party and managed-credit carve-outs.
Keep the tracked shipped-source and network audit green.
Remove the blanket claim; publish the exact boot-egress inventory instead.
Complete verified desktop coverage or narrow the advertised scope before freeze.
Prove protected stores and explicitly exclude unprotected browser state from blanket wording.
Expose and prove the full secret-free path or narrow the claim to station backup.
Prove Windows and macOS artifacts from one immutable candidate; do not claim Linux.
Prove signed Windows update and state macOS manual re-download exactly.
Keep BYOK and managed-credit economics separate and prove cap enforcement.
Prove E-STOP reach across live, routine, channel, delegated, and Night Shift work.
